name: Unica Woo Affiliate
author: tungpham42

sections.description:
Unica Woo Affiliate turns the Unica.vn course catalog into WooCommerce products. Each product is an external product whose button opens the course on Unica with your affiliate ID (and an optional coupon) attached.

Features

  • One-click import of a page of up to 15 courses, or import all remaining pages with a Stop button
  • Courses already in your store are skipped, so re-running a page is safe
  • Progress ring, stats and an activity log of recent imports
  • Test your Unica login before saving
  • Custom button text and coupon code, with a live preview
  • Automatic daily import that continues from where you stopped

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Unica.

External services

This plugin connects to the Unica.vn API (https://unica.vn) to fetch course data and your affiliate credentials. It is required for the plugin to work.

  • POST https://unica.vn/api/getToken sends the Unica username and password you enter in Settings, to obtain your affiliate ID and access token. This happens when you click “Test connection”, import courses, or when the daily import runs.
  • GET https://unica.vn/api/getCourseList and GET https://unica.vn/api/courses send your affiliate ID and access token to retrieve course data. Course thumbnails are downloaded from Unica and saved to your Media Library.

Service provider: Unica (https://unica.vn). Please review Unica’s terms of use and privacy policy on their website.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the unica-woo-affiliate folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Go to Unica Affiliate > Settings, enter your Unica username and password, and click Test connection.
  5. Open the Import tab and click Import page 1.
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes. Courses are created as WooCommerce external products.

Where is my Unica password stored?

In your site’s options table, because it is needed to request a fresh token for each import. It is removed when you delete the plugin.

Will it create duplicates?

No. Courses are matched by SKU (the Unica course ID) and skipped if they already exist.

  • AJAX import with progress, “import all remaining” and test connection
  • Fewer API calls per import, safer output escaping, better error handling
  • Daily cron scheduled on activation; uninstall cleanup added
